instruction: Place the blue and white stapler on the Green colored mat.

source.instruction: Place the blue and white stapler on the Green colored mat.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the stapler, which was at x = -22 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm to (-22, 0, 94) and orient gripper downwards with yaw +80 to align with stapler.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+8, +19, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -1, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper downwards along z to 88 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -6) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -1, 88) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm to z=78 cm and close gripper to grasp the stapler.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the stapler; closed the gripper (opening 0.18: holding the stapler)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -0, 78) opening 0.18; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift left arm up to z=88 cm to clear the table.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -0, 88) opening 0.19; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm towards the green mat at (-10.5, -9.5, 88.5).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+11, -9, +0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-11, -9, 88) opening 0.19; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw by +90 degrees to align orientation with the mat.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-11, -9, 88) opening 0.19; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower gripper to z=78 cm and open gripper to place the stapler on the mat.
